model: air; scalar paraxial; ideal pupil-conjugate phase; one scaled 2D FFT at z=f plus axial fixed-point defocus integrals

metadata.fwhm_definition: connected half-maximum width through sampled global peak at fixed z=f; not Rayleigh
metadata.rayleigh_definition: numerical first dark ring: first sign changes on both sides of the FFT field peak; cubic-spline zero crossings; mean of left/right radii and x/y sections; no 0.61*lambda/NA substitution
metadata.axial_definition: fixed transverse line through the z=f sampled peak; exact paraxial z-dependent pupil integral; no extra FFT; one common intensity normalization; no transverse peak tracking
metadata.axial_peak_definition: strongest peak on the fixed line within scan range, locally refined; boundary maximum is not accepted as a located focus
metadata.axial_rayleigh_definition: half separation of nearest near-zero intensity minima on both sides of the axial peak; minimum/peak <= 1e-4; numerical pupil integral, not theoretical substitution
metadata.section_definition: XZ at fixed y=peak_y(z=f); YZ at fixed x=peak_x(z=f); no peak tracking; one shared linear intensity normalization for both entire sections
